eth2: Ninety-eight agents have come through this branch in the sixteen years the record covers. Sixty resigned. There were four retirements, three left vested, and three transferred inside Guardian. And in all that time, there have been four terminations.

We have been through this before. In two thousand and twenty a group of our agents left together for a competitor. That was thirteen people in one year, and this branch went from forty down to twenty-seven. It took four years to get back to thirty-nine.

So this is how we rebuild. Hold the book by serving it, not by asking anyone to stay. Every household written to and matched to an agent. We chase every premium. And we select the people who come next. We do not fill seats.

And it costs you at the door as well. Recruiting was never closed here. Both unit managers were free to bring people in, and they did. What was never on offer was dropping the bar to make a number look better. Across this industry, fifteen out of every hundred people hired are still there after four years. Ours is thirty-one.
